Ship widgets in minutes, not weeks

Acme turns a folder of parts into a catalog your whole team can search, review and ship. Nothing leaves your machine, and every widget keeps its history.

Get started Install Try it free Read the docs

Search everything

Find any widget by name, tag, owner or the last person who touched it. Search runs locally and answers in milliseconds even with thousands of parts on disk.

Review with context

Every change shows what moved and why. Reviewers see the diff next to the widget it belongs to, and approvals land in the same place the work happened.

Reviews stay attached to the widget forever, so nobody has to dig through a chat thread to find out why a decision was made.

Ship from the terminal

One command builds, checks and publishes. The same command runs in CI, so the release you cut on your laptop is the release that goes out.

npx acme ship --tag v1.4.0
